prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):

   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "card", "components": [{"type": "preview", "asset": "asset:pet_interactive_preview", "style": "large", "action": "play"}, {"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Customize Companion Style", "style": "playful", "action": "choose"}]}}

   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "full_bleed", "headline": "Select Your Desktop Companion Path", "body": "Pick a preset desktop friend or create your own custom companion."}}

   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}

   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Desktop Ready Audio Alert", "style": "highlight"}, {"type": "sound", "asset": "asset:desktop_ready_chime", "action": "play"}]}}

   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "animation", "asset": "asset:confetti_sparkle", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "sound", "asset": "asset:adoption_fanfare", "action": "play"}]}}

   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Protect Your Pet Profile", "body": "Sign in to securely sync your companion, custom settings, and accessories to the cloud.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Cloud Backup Enabled", "style": "highlight"}]}}
6: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Full Bleed Gallery Redesign: Redesigns the pick friend screen into a full bleed gallery showing full-screen animated pet previews.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "full_bleed", "components": [{"type": "preview", "asset": "asset:full_screen_pet_gallery", "style": "large"}]}}

   config: {"_order": ["story", "new_style_preview", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_style_preview": {"headline": "Discover Companion Styles", "body": "Explore preset animated friends or build your own custom desktop companion.", "layout": "card"}}
8: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Habitat Generation Progress Details: Displays live stage generation updates and estimated time remaining during background asset creation on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "Rendering companion animations and preparing desktop environment..."}}
9: [sign_in, new_flow] Sign In Cloud Backup Verification Flow: Adds a cloud backup progress flow on the sign-in screen showing active profile sync status upon signing in.
   config: {"sign_in": {"components": [{"type": "progress", "label": "Verifying Cloud Sync", "style": "emphasis"}, {"type": "badge", "label": "Account Linked Successfully", "style": "highlight"}]}}

verdicts.reason: The customization flow retains the core job of letting the user choose a pet while adding interactive previews.
The full bleed redesign clearly offers both preset and custom companion path choices as required.
Reordering sign-in after adoption certificate is explicitly allowed and retains all required onboarding steps.
Adding an audio launch alert to the waiting screen complies with onboarding modification rules.
Adding celebration animations and sound effects to the adoption certificate screen is a valid onboarding enhancement.
Redesigning the sign-in screen to emphasize cloud backup status preserves its core functionality.
The redesign removes the selection control, so the pick friend screen no longer allows the user to choose a pet.
Adding a style selection preview screen before choose path is permitted and keeps all required onboarding steps intact.
Showing progress and estimated time during active asset creation represents a real wait and is allowed.
Adding a cloud sync verification indicator on the sign-in screen is a valid flow change within onboarding.
